text:
maria: Quick FYI — target cutover for SDK -> API surface changes (3.4.0) is today at 19:00 UTC. This is a staged rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation between steps. Asking for smoke owners and rollback readiness.
kevin: I can own the canary smoke checks (logs, error-rate, tail latency). Will be online at 18:45 UTC.
sam: I'll run client-compat tests against the canary bucket and watch downstream integration tests. Ping me if you need env creds.
maria: Thanks. jess, Ollie — can you confirm the rollback play? If a major regression in QA/canary, we should be able to flip the routing back to v3.3 within 3m.
jess: Rollback plan in short: 1) disable canary routing, 2) scale down new instances, 3) route traffic to v3.3, 4) revert DB-migration flag if any. I have the runbook open.
ollie: I've added a deploy-safe feature-flag check. If we hit >1.5x error-rate or 5xx spike, the monitor will page me and the bot will auto-throttle the canary. I can kick manual rollback if needed.
maria: Client comms — we have an advisory draft. Anyone want to review the copy? Short version: "We will perform a staged rollout of SDK 3.4.0; most clients unaffected; breaking change only if you call the experimental v2/alpha endpoint." We should include migration link.
sam: Suggest adding explicit guidance for retries/backoff and mention the small canary window so integrators know to expect transient errors.
kevin: Also note that embedding responses have a changed field name in v3.4 (embedding_vector -> vector). We should highlight that strongly.
jess: I can spin up a quick integration note snippet. Proposed snippet: ```If you use embeddings, rename 'embedding_vector' to 'vector' or continue using compatibility shim by setting X-SDK-Compat: 1.``` 
maria: Nice. Can we add an automated check to fail the rollout if >2 clients exhibit regression within canary? Ollie, can the routing service enforce that?
ollie: Yes — routing can be configured with a health rule: if >2 unique upstream errors flagged by our client-id header in 15m, auto-stop canary. I'll attach rule to the rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria, target: 2026-11-09T19:00:00Z, rollout: canary(5%)->25%->100%, checks: healthchecks, smoke-tests, integration-tests. Watch channel: #eng-platform.
maria: Pre-deploy checklist: code reviews merged? tags pushed? changelog updated? docs link in the advisory?
kevin: All CRs merged, tag g3.4.0 created. Changelog added to /docs/releases. I'll post the advisory link 30m before cutover.
sam: I've got the client tests queued — will post results in this thread. If anything flakey, I'll call it out.
jess: Smoke script (short): curl canary-endpoint/status, run 50 gen calls, measure p50/p95 and failure rate. I'll paste the small script in the runbook.
maria: Final ask: designated rollback lead for 19:00–20:00 UTC? Ollie volunteered earlier, but want explicit.
ollie: I will be rollback lead until 20:00 UTC. Slack phone on. :phone:
kevin: I'll be on-call for logs/infra. Sam for client-side issues, Jess for SDK/API compatibility. Maria will coordinate.
maria: Perfect. I'll post the advisory at 18:30 UTC and start the cutover at 19:00 UTC. If anyone sees urgent red flags, call out in this thread and use @ollie to trigger rollback.
sam: Got it. Will report back 18:55 with final client-test status.
jess: Runbook link: https://internal/docs/runbooks/sdk-3-4-rollout (will add smoke script there)
maria: Thanks team — see you at cutover. :rocket:
